summary: Marti Technologies filed a 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 30, 2026 announcing a technology partnership with China-based CalmCar, a provider of L2/L2+ and Level 4 autonomous driving software, to bring autonomous driving to Marti's Turkish mobility platform. No transaction consideration, equity stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The first CalmCar-equipped vehicle has arrived in Türkiye, with closed-area testing in Istanbul planned subject to permits. This is an ordinary commercial partnership announcement, not a special situation; watch permit approvals and any future capital or M&A commitments tied to the initiative.
